definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three.
